description: Sync your entire ConnectWise Automate fleet into local SQLite and answer cross-client questions the per-server web UI can't: fleet-wide health roll-ups, stale-agent sweeps, patch-compliance-by-client, and overnight drift.

novel_features.name: Fleet health board
novel_features.description: See every agent across every client in one roll-up: online/offline, last-contact age, and open-alert count, grouped by client.

novel_features.name: Stale / abandoned agents
novel_features.description: List computers not seen in N days, grouped by client — the offline agents bleeding license and hiding risk.

novel_features.name: Patch compliance by client
novel_features.description: Per-client patch posture from synced patch history joined to computers — worst offenders first.

novel_features.name: Client roll-up (QBR snapshot)
novel_features.description: One-line-per-client snapshot: computers, locations, offline agents, and open alerts — built for the client review.

novel_features.name: Cross-client alert triage
novel_features.description: Open alerts across every client, ranked by priority and joined to computer → location → client, with duplicates collapsed.

novel_features.name: OS / EOL inventory
novel_features.description: Fleet-wide operating-system distribution with end-of-life OSes (Windows 7, Server 2008/2012) flagged for upgrade planning.

novel_features.name: Fleet activity since N hours
novel_features.description: Fleet activity in the last N hours from the records' own timestamps: alerts created, agents that checked in, and patches installed.
